description: Get audio warnings when your battery is running low, plugged in, unplugged, or fully charged. Choose from 13 built-in sounds or your own WAV file for each event, and set your own warning percentages for low, critical, and emergency battery levels.
changelog:
# 1.1.0

New events: plays a sound when the charger is plugged in, unplugged,
or the battery becomes fully charged. Seven new built-in sounds
added for these events, each independently selectable like the
existing battery-level warnings.
